title: Moments Before Traffic Stop Turns into Nightmare
description:
► If you’re ever injured in an accident, you can check out Morgan & Morgan. Their fee is free unless they win. For more information, go to https://www.forthepeople.com/CodeBlueCam?s=86%3A3517

On October 14, 2023, a deputy noticed an SUV displaying signs of impaired driving in Tomah, WI. Upon approaching the polite male driver, the deputy detected an odor of intoxicants and discovered the individual had six prior OWIs. During sobriety tests, the individual suddenly refused additional tests, became extremely hostile, and resisted arrest. It was also revealed he had one open misdemeanor case, two open felony cases, and a history of disruptive behavior since 1991.
